general_policy.user_quote: Use upstream implementations as much as possible and add our fixes where appropriate.
general_policy.rule: Use upstream as the base wherever possible; preserve all missing Joom capabilities, fixes and optimizations. If behavior or an optimization is lost, preserve/adapt our part.
conditions: Confirm functional equivalence with Joom regressions and verification of native execution/plans.

For optimizations, check memory/spill lifecycle and, where possible, run available local performance measurements; explicitly identify unverified performance. Full GCP benchmarks are deferred to user validation.
A partial analogue does not constitute a complete replacement for a Joom capability.
Do not exclude Joom behavior merely because a similar mechanism exists upstream.

I01.decision: Use the Comet 1.2 native Delta scanner; preserve GCP ADC, serialization and planning-deadlock protection, adapting missing Joom behavior.

D10.decision: Use upstream Single/Final+MergeAsPartial and the new Spark aggregate-state codecs; preserve spill resilience and port Joom memory/offset guards, ordered drain and low-copy collect_list. Do not port the old Joom PartialReduce routing unless needed.

N08.decision: Keep the upstream SortAggregate architecture and add missing Joom ordering/streaming optimizations and necessary correctness guards.

I06.decision: Use upstream timestamp producer/CASE fixes and Spark 4.2 semantics; port our additional comparison normalization wherever it is still necessary.

I07.decision: Use upstream native wide-decimal hashing instead of restoring the old precision>18 prohibition; check compatibility with Spark, including mixed boundaries.

N06.decision: Use upstream native string MIN/MAX; preserve Joom cases, native coverage and missing guards.

I04.decision: Use the upstream DPP/empty-scan lifecycle; retain the corresponding Joom regressions and missing fixes.

I05.decision: Use the upstream recursive boolean FFI repair; retain additional Joom nested/sliced regressions.

J18.decision: Use upstream one-time loading of the bundled native library; verify the original Joom reload scenario.

J21.decision: Use upstream normalization of sliced broadcast offsets; retain Joom regressions and add missing fixes if behavior is lost.

J24.decision: Use the upstream small-batch/effective JVM shuffle batch cap; retain our checks.

P03.decision: Keep ANSI=true. The priority is to avoid successful jobs with incorrect results. Compare Spark 4.2.1 Comet-off/on with identical inputs/ANSI; verify results and mandatory errors; preserve SUM/AVG overflow guards, fix incompatibilities or restrict the native path before execution. Add automated regression/differential tests during implementation where possible. Do not include PR#5889 in this migration.

I03.decision: Preserve planning-deadlock protection under the current upstream core contract: UnknownPartitioning(0) without reading perPartitionData during planning; execution obtains the actual count separately. This is a verified lifecycle adaptation, not a blind port of the old always-zero behavior.

technical_clarification.previous_preinvestigation_wording: Preserve planning-deadlock protection through the current upstream lifecycle with the correct execution partition count; do not copy the old unconditional UnknownPartitioning(0). Verify the original Joom reproductions.
evidence: upstream operators.scala:1382 forbids perPartitionData reads in outputPartitioning and prescribes Unknown0
operators.scala:1135 derives runtime count independently from perPartitionData.length
ordinary CometNativeScanExec.scala:131 and Spark4.2.1 DataSourceScanExec.scala:482 return Unknown0 for nonbucketed scans
technical_clarification.relative_plan_limit: Compared with obsolete contrib Unknown1 path, a one-split Delta scan may get an additional SinglePartition exchange; not measured. Matches standard Spark and source Joom, so no agreed Joom feature is lost.

J09.decision: Preserve the Joom projection-instance pool on top of the upstream generated-class cache, respecting lifetime/bounds guards. A partial class cache alone does not replace the pool; simplification is allowed only after equivalence is confirmed under the approved rule.

ansi_policy.rule: The target Spark 4.2.1 mode is ANSI=true. Fix confirmed incompatibilities or restrict the corresponding native path before execution; do not globally disable ANSI to work around differences.

correctness_policy.priority: Prevent a job from completing without error and publishing an incorrect result.
correctness_policy.user_quote: Above all, we must do everything possible to prevent a job from completing without error while producing an incorrect result.
release_criteria: Known unsafe native paths are fixed or excluded through a planned fallback before execution; a green job/CI status alone is insufficient.
Compare Spark 4.2.1 without and with Comet on the same input snapshot, with identical ANSI=true and other significant settings.
Compare actual results, types, NULLs, duplicate rows and guaranteed SQL order; do not rely solely on counts or selected sums.
Check both sides of the contract: must succeed/must fail. Comet success instead of a mandatory Spark ANSI error is a correctness violation.
Preserve overflow detection and guards for mixed Spark/native partial-final SUM/AVG, including the new state codec.
For a confirmed incompatibility, select fallback before execution/publication; do not rely on retrying in Spark after a write or error.
Verify actual native execution/plans so that fallback does not conceal a lack of testing of the custom path.
Do not conceal differences through broad normalization, lost duplicates or arbitrary float tolerances; respect defined Spark semantics and permitted nondeterminism.
correctness_policy.automated_regressions: Where possible, add automated regression/differential tests during implementation; this historical entry records the plan without writing code.
priority_cases: Mixed Spark/native decimal SUM/AVG and intermediate overflow, forced spill and the new PartialMerge codec.
Separately cover decimal SUM runtime codegen fallback; static NO_CODEGEN guards are insufficient.
Grouped decimal AVG + LIMIT, malformed casts, arithmetic overflow, division by zero and lazy AND/OR/CASE/JVM dispatch.
SMJ hoisting: can-throw expressions/conditional branches/outer join, ANSI=true.
Custom RANGE windows at DATE/DECIMAL boundaries and existing fallback guards.
Results with active Joom cost/boundary flags, mixed shuffle, AQE on/off; verification of native plans.
Known silent-result edge cases independently of ANSI, including BINARY-to-STRING/invalid UTF8, where applicable.
correctness_policy.limits: A test suite is not a mathematical proof of the absence of all bugs. Explicitly record uncovered risks; do not claim compatibility has been proved without verification.
